newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index edges up in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index edges up in lower turnover.

text.p: The share index of the Bahrain Stock Exchange edged up in the week to Thursday in lower turnover focused on the banking sector, official figures showed.
The exchange said the index climbed 5.48 points to 1,629.85 points from 1,624.37 points the previous week.
More than 12.3 million shares worth 2.26 million dinars ($6 million) were traded in the week, down from 13.4 million shares worth 2.9 million dinars a week earlier.
Shares of 25 of the 39 firms listed in the exchange changed hands in 272 transactions.

Bahrain Middle East Bank continued to lead the market for the third week running with around 7.2 million shares worth 983,500 dinars changing hands. The bank's shares closed on Thursday 11 fils up at 138 fils each.
The bourse said 603,249 shares of Bahrain Telecommunications Co worth 253,965 dinars were traded. Its shares ended the week unchanged at 422 fils each.
Investcorp shares lost one U.S. cent to close on Thursday at $1.86 each and Bahrain International Bank dropped one fils to 183 fils each. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424. ($1=0.377 dinar)
